title: Upgrade all packages using pamac
summary: Use pamac to update all installed packages to their latest versions. This keeps your system secure and up to date.

steps.explain: Upgrade all installed packages to their latest versions.

rollback.explain: Downgrading packages is complex and not directly supported by a single pamac command. Use pamac downgrade if available or restore from a snapshot.

warnings: Upgrading packages can sometimes cause system instability. Ensure you have a backup or snapshot.
